??? example "Queue settings from the constructor"

    ```php title="app/Jobs/BaseJob.php"
    namespace App\Jobs;

    use Illuminate\Bus\Queueable;

    abstract class BaseJob
    {
        use Queueable;

        public function __construct()
        {
            $this->onConnection('sqs');
        }
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Jobs/ShipOrder.php"
    namespace App\Jobs;

    use Illuminate\Contracts\Queue\ShouldQueue;

    class ShipOrder extends BaseJob implements ShouldQueue
    {
        public $queue = 'default';

        public function __construct(bool $urgent = false)
        {
            parent::__construct(); // → jobs[ShipOrder].queue_config.connection sqs
            $this->onQueue('shipping'); // → jobs[ShipOrder].queue_config.queue shipping
            $this->delay(60); // → jobs[ShipOrder].queue_config.delay 60
            $this->afterCommit(); // → jobs[ShipOrder].queue_config.after_commit true

            if ($urgent) {
                $this->onQueue('urgent');
            }
        }
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Jobs/RestockOrder.php"
    namespace App\Jobs;

    use Illuminate\Bus\Queueable;
    use Illuminate\Contracts\Queue\ShouldQueueAfterCommit;

    class RestockOrder implements ShouldQueueAfterCommit
    {
        use Queueable;

        public function __construct()
        {
            $this->queue = 'restock'; // → jobs[RestockOrder].queue_config.queue restock
            $this->beforeCommit(); // → jobs[RestockOrder].queue_config.after_commit false
        }
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Http/Controllers/PaymentController.php"
    namespace App\Http\Controllers;

    use App\Actions\ChargeCard;
    use App\Actions\RefundCard;
    use App\Actions\VoidCard;
    use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Bus;

    class PaymentController
    {
        public function store(): void
        {
            ChargeCard::dispatch(); // → jobs[ChargeCard].dispatched_from.method PaymentController::store
            Bus::dispatch(new RefundCard); // → jobs[RefundCard].dispatched_from.method PaymentController::store
            dispatch(new RefundCard); // → jobs[RefundCard].dispatched_from.method PaymentController::store
            VoidCard::dispatch(); // ✗ target_not_indexed
        }
    }
    ```

??? example "Queue settings from properties"

    ```php title="app/Jobs/BaseJob.php"
    namespace App\Jobs;

    abstract class BaseJob
    {
        public $tries = 5;

        public $timeout = 120;
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Jobs/ExportOrders.php"
    namespace App\Jobs;

    use Illuminate\Contracts\Queue\ShouldQueue;

    class ExportOrders extends BaseJob implements ShouldQueue // → jobs.queue_config.timeout 120
    {
        public $connection = 'redis'; // → jobs[ExportOrders].queue_config.connection redis

        public $queue = 'exports'; // → jobs[ExportOrders].queue_config.queue exports

        public $delay = 30; // → jobs[ExportOrders].queue_config.delay 30

        public $tries = 3; // → jobs[ExportOrders].queue_config.tries 3

        public $backoff = 10; // → jobs[ExportOrders].queue_config.backoff 10

        public $afterCommit = false; // → jobs[ExportOrders].queue_config.after_commit false
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Jobs/ImportOrders.php"
    namespace App\Jobs;

    use Illuminate\Contracts\Queue\ShouldQueue;

    class ImportOrders implements ShouldQueue // → jobs.queue_config.after_commit null
    {
        public $queue = self::QUEUE; // → jobs[ImportOrders].queue_config.queue null

        public const QUEUE = 'imports';

        public function backoff(): array // → jobs[ImportOrders].queue_config.backoff null
        {
            return [5];
        }
    }
    ```
